title: Hold Length Loading on the Restart Re-Pricing of Professional Services Projects
content:
For a fixed-fee Professional Services Projects engagement re-priced on restart, the length of the hold adds re-planning and escalation to the restart re-pricing.

## Clause

For the hold, the restart re-pricing rests on the hold length, the calendar days from the on-hold date to the resumed date, and on the full months on hold counted the same way, a whole month being complete only on the same day number of a later month. A hold shorter than one and a half times the class hold limit adds nothing under this clause; a hold of one and a half times the class hold limit or longer adds to the restart re-pricing a re-planning block of 16 hours at the class solutions architect rate; a hold of twice the class hold limit or longer adds both the re-planning block and an escalation of 9.0 percent a year of the remaining value pro-rated by the full months on hold, so that a longer hold is never re-priced lower than a shorter one.

| Hold length | Added to the restart re-pricing |
|---|---|
| shorter than one and a half times the class hold limit | nothing |
| one and a half times the class hold limit or longer, shorter than twice it | the re-planning block: 16 hours at the class solutions architect rate |
| twice the class hold limit or longer | the re-planning block, and the remaining value multiplied by 9.0 percent and by the full months on hold divided by 12 |

## Thresholds and re-planning block by class

| Engagement class | Hold limit (days) | One and a half times | Twice | Solutions architect rate | Re-planning block |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Assessment Engagement | 30 | 45 | 60 | 245.00 | 3920.00 |
| Quick Start Project | 30 | 45 | 60 | 245.00 | 3920.00 |
| Standard Project | 45 | 67.5 (68 days or more) | 90 | 240.00 | 3840.00 |
| Advanced Project | 60 | 90 | 120 | 230.00 | 3680.00 |
| Major Project | 90 | 135 | 180 | 220.00 | 3520.00 |
| Strategic Program | 90 | 135 | 180 | 210.00 | 3360.00 |

## Worked case (hypothetical figures)

An Advanced Project held from 10 January to 15 August of a year that is not a leap year: 217 calendar days, which is twice the 60-day limit or longer, and 7 full months. On a remaining value of 50000.00 the clause adds 3680.00 and 50000.00 multiplied by 9.0 percent and by 7 divided by 12, that is 2625.00.
